content_data.meeting_title: Claims Processing API Architecture Review & Q4 Sprint Planning
agenda_items: Discuss UX improvements for mobile claims submission flow
Address API rate limiting issues affecting third-party integrations
Security audit findings for customer data encryption layer
Review microservices architecture for real-time claims adjudication system
key_decisions: Implement GraphQL gateway to reduce mobile app API calls and improve response times by 40%
Postpone legacy system migration until after mobile app v3.0 release in 6 weeks
technical_blockers: Insufficient test coverage (currently 62%) blocking CI/CD pipeline automation for claims module
Database migration scripts failing on production replica due to schema conflicts with audit tables
Third-party identity verification service experiencing intermittent outages causing claim submission failures
Legacy mainframe API lacks documentation and has unpredictable response times affecting integration timeline
